name: Duality
source:
What started out as an attempt to flirt with a cute guy lands you in the middle of a bizarre love triangle. But that shouldn't be too bad, right? Situations like this are normally dramatic and exciting. They make you feel like the beloved lead of a romance novel. Well in this case, things are a little more sinister than that. You might want to consider your choices carefully. Somebody's life could depend on it...

Duality is an erotic horror game about two unstable individuals trying to win you over through every romantic and gruesome way possible. 

[From [url=https://nightmareweaverz.itch.io/duality]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你原本只是想和一個可愛的男孩調情，卻因此捲入一段離奇的三角戀。聽起來應該還好吧？這種情形通常既戲劇化又刺激，讓人感覺自己像浪漫小說的主角。但這一次，事情要陰暗得多。你最好慎重考慮每個選擇，因為某個人的性命可能取決於此……

《Duality》是一款情色恐怖遊戲，兩個情緒不穩定的人正試圖用各種浪漫又殘酷的方式贏得你的心。

[摘自[url=https://nightmareweaverz.itch.io/duality]Itch.io[/url]]
